title: Could You Survive a $400 Emergency? Most People Can't

scenes.heading: WAIT.
lines: Could you pay a four hundred dollar emergency today? In cash? Be honest.

scenes.heading: Most can't
lines: More than a third of Americans couldn't. And that's exactly how the debt trap starts.

scenes.heading: The trap
lines: The car breaks, it goes on the credit card, and the interest eats your next month.

scenes.heading: The fix
lines: Here's the fix. Forget six months of savings. Start with just five hundred dollars.

scenes.heading: How?
lines: Ten dollars a week. That's it. That's five hundred and twenty dollars in one year.

scenes.heading: Autopilot
lines: Set it to move automatically on payday, so you never even see it.

scenes.heading: Hide it
lines: Keep it in a separate savings account. Not your checking. Out of sight, out of mind.

scenes.heading: No panic
lines: So next time life hits you with a surprise? You just pay it. No panic.

scenes.heading: Full plan
lines: Want the full step by step plan? It's in the full video on my channel.
